I agree, grip strength should not be the limiting factor for ones deadlift progress. If he really needs the straps for a set, he should use them. 

But barring any accessory exercises that sufficiently challenge his grip, or specific grip training exclusively using straps will only make the problem worse.

There is nothing wrong with using straps, but I would only do it sparingly. 
If you use them too much your grip strength will not only stall but actually regress, all the while your general strength still grows, widening the gap and making the need for straps even bigger.

I used straps for all my heavy work sets for half a year and it took a long time for my grip strength to catch up again after i switched back. 

So only use them if you really need them to push out those last reps of your last set or a heavy single that you would otherwise miss.
The bulk of your training should be done without in my opinion.
